title: Computational Multi-Agents Society Experiments: Social Modeling Framework Based on Generative Agents
abstract: arXiv:2508.17366v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Computational social science has developed descriptive, interpretative, and predictive modeling, but comprehensive modeling combining in-world human intervention with outcome forecasting remains underexplored. Generative agent-based platforms scale populations or reproduce complex scenarios, but researchers typically act through setup, external controls, or post-hoc analysis rather than in-world roles. We introduce Computational Multi-Agent Society Experiments (CMASE), a generative agent-based framework for in-world researcher participation and traceable interventions at runtime. Treating simulation as a simulated ethnographic field, CMASE supports (1) real-time human-computer interaction to study intervention processes; (2) controlled experiments with ethnography-inspired observation, interviewing, and interpretation; and (3) forward exploration of intervention trajectories and downstream responses. translated_title: 计算多智能体社会实验：基于生成式智能体的社会建模框架
translated_abstract: 计算社会科学已经发展出描述性、解释性和预测性建模，但将场景内人类干预与结果预测相结合的综合建模仍未得到充分探索。基于生成式智能体的平台可以扩展人口规模或重现复杂场景，但研究人员通常通过初始设置、外部控制或事后分析来开展工作，而非以场景内角色的身份参与其中。我们提出了计算多智能体社会实验（CMASE），这是一个基于生成式智能体的框架，支持研究人员的场景内参与以及运行时可追溯的干预。CMASE将模拟视为一个模拟的民族志田野，支持：（1）实时人机交互以研究干预过程；（2）借鉴民族志的观察、访谈和解释方法开展受控实验；（3）对干预轨迹和下游响应的前瞻性探索。CMASE结合了大语言模型驱动的感知……
tldr: 本文提出CMASE框架，首次允许研究人员以场景内角色身份实时参与生成式智能体社会模拟并进行可追溯的干预，将模拟视为模拟民族志田野，从而支持实时人机交互研究、民族志式受控实验以及干预轨迹与下游响应的前瞻性探索。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CMASE, a generative agent-based framework that enables researchers to participate in-world and perform traceable interventions during simulation runtime, treating the simulation as a simulated ethnographic field to support real-time human-agent interaction, ethnography-inspired controlled experiments, and forward exploration of intervention trajectories and downstream responses.
